name: verified-survivor-equal-planning-ages
description: Fixture rules, MFJ couple born the same year with equal planning ages: nobody dies inside the horizon, so the spousal excess (claimed 36 months early: own 0.82, spousal 0.784) continues to the end and the filing status stays MFJ; RMDs from 73 (§7.5, §7.7).

capitalMarket.note: Illustrative round-number assumptions chosen by the app authors; not a forecast.
